steps: LLM call with forced JSON response

bottlenecks.issue: Overly constrained prompts forcing structured JSON responses
bottlenecks.details: Complex prompts with 300+ lines of instructions, forcing specific JSON schemas

bottlenecks.issue: Multiple API endpoints for what should be a single conversation
bottlenecks.impact: Fragments the conversation across multiple requests
bottlenecks.details: translate, clarify, interactive-refine endpoints instead of single chat endpoint

bottlenecks.issue: Frontend managing conversation state and flow
bottlenecks.impact: App logic overrides LLM conversational guidance
bottlenecks.details: Forces users through specific component flows, tracks confidence scores, manages state

bottlenecks.impact: Adds latency and complexity to simple conversations
bottlenecks.details: Every clarification saved as database record

simplificationOpportunities.proposed: Natural language in/out with light parsing

simplificationOpportunities.current: Complex state management and flow control
simplificationOpportunities.proposed: Simple chat interface displaying LLM responses directly

keyInsight: The app is treating the LLM as a structured data service rather than a conversational AI. Every layer adds constraints that prevent the LLM from having natural, helpful conversations with users.
